name: octaweave_delete_note
description: Permanently delete a note. Not reversible and not a trash operation — there is no undo. Confirm with the user before calling this on anything you did not create in this session.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.
